subject: geography
note: Original class-wise notes following NCERT geography 6–12. Two books each in 11 and 12.

chapters.title: The Earth in the Solar System
chapters.summary: The Sun, planets, the Moon, asteroids. Earth is a unique mix of air, water and life. Latitudes of other planets help contrast.

chapters.title: Globe: Latitudes and Longitudes
chapters.summary: Axis, equator, tropics, poles, longitudes and time. Standard meridians and IST (82°30′ E).

chapters.title: Motions of the Earth
chapters.summary: Rotation (day–night) and revolution (seasons, leap year). Equinoxes and solstices. Tilt of 23½° is the seasonal key.

chapters.title: Maps
chapters.summary: Scale, direction, conventional signs, sketch vs plan vs map. Physical, political and thematic maps.

chapters.title: Major Domains of the Earth
chapters.summary: Lithosphere, hydrosphere, atmosphere, biosphere. Continents and oceans. Interaction of spheres is environment.

chapters.title: Major Landforms of the Earth
chapters.summary: Mountains, plateaus, plains—internal (tectonic) vs external (erosion) processes. Young fold mountains vs old plateaus.

chapters.title: Our Country — India
chapters.summary: Location, neighbours, tropic of Cancer, standard meridian, political divisions. India’s size and latitudinal spread explain climate variety.

chapters.title: India: Climate, Vegetation and Wildlife
chapters.summary: Monsoon climate, forests (tropical to alpine), wildlife and protection. Climate drives vegetation.

chapters.title: Environment
chapters.summary: Natural, human and human-made components. Ecosystem as interaction. Balance and human impact.

chapters.title: Inside Our Earth
chapters.summary: Crust, mantle, core; rocks (igneous, sedimentary, metamorphic) and the rock cycle. Minerals as building blocks.

chapters.title: Our Changing Earth
chapters.summary: Lithospheric plates, earthquakes, volcanoes, and work of river, wind, ice, sea waves. Landforms have processes.

chapters.title: Air
chapters.summary: Atmosphere composition, structure, weather vs climate, wind, moisture. Greenhouse idea at a simple level.

chapters.title: Water
chapters.summary: Water cycle, salinity, tides, ocean currents, distribution of water. Freshwater is scarce.

chapters.title: Natural Vegetation and Wildlife
chapters.summary: Forests, grasslands, shrubs; factors of climate and soil. Conservation of flora and fauna.

chapters.title: Human Environment — Settlement, Transport, Communication
chapters.summary: Rural–urban settlements, transport modes, communication as development infrastructure.

chapters.title: Human Environment Interactions — Tropical and Subtropical Region
chapters.summary: Amazon and Ganga–Brahmaputra: life in rainforests and river plains. Environment shapes livelihood.

chapters.title: Life in the Temperate Grasslands
chapters.summary: Prairies and velds: climate, wheat–cattle economies, Chinook. Compare with Indian plains.

chapters.title: Life in the Deserts
chapters.summary: Sahara (hot) and Ladakh (cold): adaptations, water, tourism and change.

chapters.title: Resources
chapters.summary: Natural, human, human-made; renewable vs non-renewable; sustainable development. Resource is technology + need, not just stuff.

chapters.title: Land, Soil, Water, Natural Vegetation and Wildlife Resources
chapters.summary: Land use, soil formation and types, water scarcity, forest and wildlife conservation. Degradation is a policy issue.

chapters.title: Mineral and Power Resources
chapters.summary: Metallic–non-metallic minerals, distribution, conventional vs non-conventional energy. Mining has costs.

chapters.title: Agriculture
chapters.summary: Farm types, major crops, agricultural development, farm system. Green Revolution as a mixed blessing.

chapters.title: Industries
chapters.summary: Classification, locational factors, case studies (textiles, steel, IT, Jamshedpur). Industry is geography + policy.

chapters.title: Human Resources
chapters.summary: People as resource: distribution, density, age–sex, literacy. Population is both strength and planning challenge.

chapters.title: India — Size and Location
chapters.summary: Lat–long, standard meridian, neighbours, central location in the Indian Ocean. Size shapes climate and time.

chapters.title: Physical Features of India
chapters.summary: Tectonic origin of Himalayas, Northern Plains, Peninsular Plateau, Desert, Coasts, Islands. The master map of India.

chapters.title: Drainage
chapters.summary: Himalayan vs peninsular rivers, Ganga system, Brahmaputra, west-flowing rivers, lakes, national river-linking debates at a basic level.

chapters.title: Climate
chapters.summary: Monsoon mechanism, seasons, rainfall distribution, climate controls (latitude, relief, ENSO intro). Drought and flood.

chapters.title: Natural Vegetation and Wildlife
chapters.summary: Forest types, biosphere reserves, fauna. Vegetation follows rainfall and altitude.

chapters.title: Population
chapters.summary: Size, distribution, density, growth, age composition, NPP. Census as source.

chapters.title: Resources and Development
chapters.summary: Resource planning, land degradation, soil types of India, soil conservation. Agenda 21 idea of sustainable planning.

chapters.title: Forest and Wildlife Resources
chapters.summary: Biodiversity, Forest Acts, types of forests, community conservation (sacred groves), Chipko as a story of people.

chapters.title: Water Resources
chapters.summary: Water scarcity is social as well as physical. Dams, multi-purpose projects, rainwater harvesting. Conflicts over rivers.

chapters.title: Agriculture
chapters.summary: Cropping patterns (rabi, kharif, zaid), major crops, institutional reforms, Green Revolution, food security.

chapters.title: Minerals and Energy Resources
chapters.summary: Distribution of coal, petroleum, atomic minerals, non-conventional energy. Conservation.

chapters.title: Manufacturing Industries
chapters.summary: Locational factors, agro-based and mineral-based, industrial pollution. Manufacturing as development.

chapters.title: Lifelines of National Economy
chapters.summary: Road, rail, air, water, pipelines, trade. Golden Quadrilateral, ports. Communication and tourism as economy.

chapters.title: Geography as a Discipline
chapters.summary: Physical vs human, dualism, and why geography integrates nature and society.

chapters.title: The Origin and Evolution of the Earth
chapters.summary: Nebular hypothesis, Big Bang context, formation of crust, atmosphere, life. Geological time at a glance.

chapters.title: Interior of the Earth
chapters.summary: Earthquake waves, shadow zones, crust–mantle–core, volcanoes. Evidence is geophysical.

chapters.title: Distribution of Oceans and Continents
chapters.summary: Continental drift, seafloor spreading, plate tectonics, force behind plates.

chapters.title: Geomorphic Processes
chapters.summary: Endogenic–exogenic, weathering, mass wasting, erosion–deposition. Landform = process + time + rock.

chapters.title: Landforms and their Evolution
chapters.summary: Running water, groundwater, glaciers, waves, wind—each suite of landforms. Indian examples (Himalayan rivers, Thar, coasts).

chapters.title: Composition and Structure of Atmosphere
chapters.summary: Gases, layers up to exosphere, weather vs climate. Ozone.

chapters.title: Solar Radiation, Heat Balance and Temperature
chapters.summary: Insolation, heat budget, inversion, temperature distribution. Why continents heat faster.

chapters.title: Atmospheric Circulation and Weather Systems
chapters.summary: Pressure belts, winds, jet streams, air masses, fronts, cyclones, anticyclones. Monsoon is a later India-book topic but the physics starts here.

chapters.title: Water in the Atmosphere
chapters.summary: Humidity, condensation, rainfall types, world precipitation pattern.

chapters.title: World Climate and Climate Change
chapters.summary: Koeppen types, climate change causes and evidence. Link to IPCC language in current affairs.

chapters.title: Water (Oceans)
chapters.summary: Relief of ocean floor, temperature, salinity. Horizontal and vertical distribution.

chapters.title: Movements of Ocean Water
chapters.summary: Waves, tides, currents (warm/cold), El Niño as current–climate coupler.

chapters.title: Biodiversity and Conservation
chapters.summary: Genetic–species–ecosystem diversity, hotspots, IUCN, in-situ vs ex-situ. Normative conservation.

chapters.title: India — Location
chapters.summary: Size, extent, standard meridian, Indian Ocean centrality, neighbours. Repeat from 9 but at plus-two depth.

chapters.title: Structure and Physiography
chapters.summary: Geological divisions (Peninsular block, Himalayas, Indo-Ganga plain) and physiographic units in detail.

chapters.title: Drainage System
chapters.summary: Evolution of Himalayan vs peninsular drainage, river regimes, river basins, problems (floods, linking).

chapters.title: Climate
chapters.summary: Monsoon mechanism (Tibet heat, ITCZ, jets), seasons, Koeppen for India, variability, climate and life.

chapters.title: Natural Vegetation
chapters.summary: Forest types mapped to rainfall and altitude; conservation, social forestry.

chapters.title: Soils
chapters.summary: Soil-forming factors, Indian soil types, erosion and conservation. Alluvial vs black vs red vs laterite vs arid vs forest.

chapters.title: Natural Hazards and Disasters
chapters.summary: Floods, droughts, cyclones, earthquakes, landslides. NDMA mindset: preparedness over panic. Bihar floods belong here.

chapters.title: Human Geography: Nature and Scope
chapters.summary: Human geography studies people–place relations: cultural, economic, political. Approaches from environmental determinism to possibilism.

chapters.title: The World Population
chapters.summary: Growth, distribution, density, demographic transition, Malthus vs reality. Migration types.

chapters.title: Population Composition
chapters.summary: Age–sex, rural–urban, literacy, occupation, pyramids. Composition tells development.

chapters.title: Human Development
chapters.summary: HDI, income–health–education, Sen’s capabilities flavour. Growth is not development.

chapters.title: Primary Activities
chapters.summary: Hunting, gathering, pastoralism, mining, agriculture types (intensive, extensive, plantation, Mediterranean).

chapters.title: Secondary Activities
chapters.summary: Manufacturing systems, industry classification, high-tech industry, traditional large-scale.

chapters.title: Tertiary and Quaternary Activities
chapters.summary: Services, trade, transport, communication, IT, knowledge economy. Quinary as decision-making.

chapters.title: Transport and Communication
chapters.summary: World rail, road, sea, air, pipelines, internet. Suez, Panama, trans-Siberian as classics.

chapters.title: International Trade
chapters.summary: Basis of trade, WTO, ports as gateways, concerns of developing countries.

chapters.title: Human Settlements
chapters.summary: Rural patterns, urban types, megacities, problems of urbanisation.

chapters.title: Population: Distribution, Density, Growth and Composition
chapters.summary: Census India: density belts, growth phases, language, religion, rural–urban. Bihar’s density and out-migration belong here.

chapters.title: Migration: Types, Causes and Consequences
chapters.summary: Inter-state streams, Gulf migration, rural–urban. Remittances and social costs. Bihar as origin.

chapters.title: Human Development
chapters.summary: Indian HDI variation across states. Health, education, income gaps. Planning for capability.

chapters.title: Human Settlements
chapters.summary: Indian villages, urbanisation, smart cities debate, slums, conurbations (Delhi, Mumbai).

chapters.title: Land Resources and Agriculture
chapters.summary: Land-use change, cropping intensity, Green–White–Blue revolutions, agricultural problems, food security.

chapters.title: Water Resources
chapters.summary: Surface–groundwater, irrigation, watershed, inter-state disputes, pollution. Eastern India’s flood-and-scarcity paradox.

chapters.title: Mineral and Energy Resources
chapters.summary: Distribution, energy mix, nuclear, renewables, conservation. Jharkhand–Odisha–Chhattisgarh mineral belt vs Bihar’s limited minerals.

chapters.title: Manufacturing Industries
chapters.summary: Industrial regions of India, liberalisation impact, pollution. Location still follows raw material, power, market, policy.

chapters.title: Planning and Sustainable Development in Indian Context
chapters.summary: Five-year plans to NITI, hill-area, drought, command area, ITDP. Sustainable development as method.

chapters.title: Transport and Communication
chapters.summary: Indian rail gauges history, NH, ports, airways, ISRO communication. Lifelines at national scale.

chapters.title: International Trade
chapters.summary: India’s trade composition, direction, seaports and airports as gateways.

chapters.title: Geographical Perspective on Selected Issues
chapters.summary: Pollution, urban waste, rural–urban migration, problems of slums. Geography as applied civic science.
